variants.text: face shape: oval; forehead: moderately high, gently rounded contour; cheekbones: average width and projection; jawline: defined; chin: rounded; hair: short tousled light brown; eyebrows: medium thickness, soft-arched, moderately spaced; eyes: almond-shaped, medium palpebral fissure length, neutral canthal tilt, visible upper-lid crease; nose: straight dorsum, medium bridge width, rounded tip; mouth: medium width, thin upper and lower lips, level corners, upper teeth showing; facial hair: light stubble along jawline and chin; ears: free lobes, metal ring piercing in left lobe

Short tousled light brown hair and a metal ring piercing in the left ear lobe characterize this individual, who has an oval face with a defined jawline and rounded chin. They exhibit light stubble along the jawline and chin, medium-thickness soft-arched eyebrows, and almond-shaped eyes with a neutral canthal tilt. The nose has a straight dorsum with a rounded tip, while the mouth features thin lips and shows upper teeth in a smile.
